name: Preserve functional blocks through reusable placement and regenerate telemetry pod
description_html:
Direct owner change request to chief coordinator agent-529, 2026-10-23. Deliver both a manufacturing-ready telemetry pod and useful reusable agent-ee capability. Repair the existing block model and enforcement, then regenerate the board.

Investigate block definitions through initial placement, side assignment, global optimization, legalization, and routing feedback. Determine whether eligible components can really change sides. Trace current code and the exact R1-R5 production execution; existing related work includes AGENTEE-339, AGENTEE-340, AGENTEE-355, AGENTEE-439, AGENTEE-341 and AGENTEE-391. Their completion does not prove current target behavior.

  • Every footprint has explicit functional-block membership or a shared/fixed role. Shared supply/ground nets do not merge unrelated blocks.
  • Establish sourced fixed mechanical/interface anchors, place blocks across allowed board area and sides, then refine members while retaining locality.
  • Allow eligible whole-block side changes and deliberate cross-face adjacency; record sourced mechanical, thermal, RF and assembly restrictions. Optimize connectivity/congestion, not equal side counts.
  • Enforce device-to-support relationships for decoupling, feedback, filtering and protection; measure relevant pin/interface proximity. Bounding boxes alone are insufficient.
  • Global placement, legalization and routing adjustments retain all declared block constraints. Move/reshape/re-side affected blocks or report infeasibility. Any relaxation is explicit and reported.
  • Apply sourced screw/washer/standoff, connector/access, antenna, enclosure/thermal keepouts, courtyards and height restrictions on the relevant faces before packing.

Acceptance: regenerated full telemetry-pod board; final-coordinate per-block membership/side/spread/internal-connection-length/violation report; top/bottom block-annotated views; final mechanical validation; evidence that eligible underside space is evaluated and selected where it improves a constrained layout; congestion regression through global placement and legalization; explicit unresolved constraints. Routing completion and native DRC are additional gates, not proof of functional grouping. Retain original candidates as baselines.

Coordinator 529 owns direction and acceptance. All communication through 519. Dispatcher/integrator 449 selects existing holders, subscription models, admitted hosts, immutable inputs, independent verifier and finite budgets. First action: one bounded source/production trace with a proposed repair boundary, not a new router run. ROUTE-4 remains suspended. No new agents, cloud restart, orders or uploads. Later routing and final electrical/RF/mechanical/fabrication qualification remain required by the full goal.
